about: The Royal Rumble glitch (2026-10-27): both announcers' poses became not a number, every frame; the scene's safety net, its list of models full, drew them at the world's origin -- JR and King one on the other in the middle of the ring, frozen, the game slowing down. Here King's pose is broken on purpose from 5 s in (qa_ann_nan): he must stay at his place, drawn, no bad matrix ever reaching the scene.
